page.title: 人・場所・時を報告者目線へ

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、間接話法で単語を機械的に交換するのではなく、報告者がいる人間関係・場所・時点から指示対象を再配置する方法を扱う。I・you・myなどの人称、here・there、now・then、today・that day、yesterday・the day before、tomorrow・the next day、ago・earlierを状況に応じて選び、同じ場所・同じ日なら元の語を保てる柔軟性も確認する。さらにpromise・advise・warn・complain・admitで発言の機能を表す。
grammarPoints: 元発言のI・you・we・myなどを発言者・聞き手・報告者の関係に合わせて三人称や目的格へ変える
報告場所が異なる場合はhere→there、同じ場所ならhereを保てる
now→then、today→that day、yesterday→the day before、tomorrow→the next day、next week→the following weekなどを報告時点に合わせる
agoは発言時の現在を基準にするため、過去の報告ではearlier・beforeで過去の基準点から遡る
語句変換は状況が変わるときだけ行い、同日・同場所・即時報告では元表現を残せる
promise・advise・warn・complain・admitなどを使って発言の約束・助言・警告・不満・自認という働きを表す
visualEvidence: 人物・場所・時間の三方向へ回転する視点コンパス
発言者Iと聞き手youが報告文ではhe・she・meなどへつながる指示矢印
now／today／yesterday／tomorrow／ago／hereを状況に応じて変換する可動式ホイール
agoが発言時点から、earlierが過去の報告時点から遡ることを示す時間軸
promise・advise・warn・complain・admitを発言機能別に選ぶ色分けされた伝達動詞パレット
commonTraps: 発言者のIを報告者自身のIとして残し、人物の指示対象を変えてしまう
報告場所が同じでもhereを必ずthereへ、同じ日でもtodayを必ずthat dayへ変える
過去の発言を報告するときにagoを現在時点から数え直してしまう
tomorrow・next week・yesterdayの基準となる発言日を確認しない
promise・warn・complain・admitを意味の近さだけで選び、元発言の機能を無視する
advise＋人＋to、complain＋that節など伝達動詞ごとの型を混同する

questions.prompt: On Tuesday, Ms. Cole reported that the shipment would arrive -------.

choices.A: today from Monday
choices.B: yesterday
choices.C: ago
choices.D: that day

questions.translationJa: 火曜日、コールさんは荷物がその日に到着すると報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 火曜日の報告時点で同じ火曜日を指すため、直接話法のtodayはthat dayと表せます。

questions.prompt: The sales manager called from Nagoya and said that she would remain ------- until Friday.

choices.A: here at headquarters
choices.B: there
choices.C: then day
choices.D: ago

questions.translationJa: 営業部長は名古屋から電話し、金曜日までそこに滞在すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告者が名古屋とは別の場所にいるため、発言者のhereはthereへ変わります。

questions.prompt: The clerk said that the last bus had left five minutes -------.

choices.A: earlier
choices.B: ago from now
choices.C: tomorrow
choices.D: next

questions.translationJa: 係員は、最終バスが5分前に出たと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の発言時点を基準に遡るため、現在基準のagoではなくearlierを使います。

questions.prompt: Mr. Hassan said that ------- would send me his revised proposal.

choices.A: I
choices.B: you
choices.C: he
choices.D: they me

questions.translationJa: ハッサンさんは、彼が私に改訂案を送ると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 元発言の話者Mr. Hassanを間接話法内で指すため、三人称単数heを選びます。

questions.prompt: The coordinator said on Monday that the workshop would begin -------.

choices.A: tomorrow now
choices.B: the next day
choices.C: the day before
choices.D: then ago

questions.translationJa: 調整担当者は月曜日、研修会は翌日に始まると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の月曜日から見たtomorrowはthe next dayに変えます。

questions.prompt: The safety officer ------- that the loading area might become slippery.

choices.A: promised
choices.B: admitted
choices.C: congratulated
choices.D: warned

questions.translationJa: 安全担当者は、積み込み区域が滑りやすくなる可能性があると警告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 危険の可能性を伝える文脈なのでwarnedが最適です。

questions.prompt: Several guests ------- that the air-conditioning was too noisy.

choices.A: promised
choices.B: advised
choices.C: complained
choices.D: admitted to us a promise

questions.translationJa: 数名の宿泊客は、空調の音が大きすぎると不満を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 不満の内容をthat節で続けるためcomplainedが自然です。

questions.prompt: The project leader ------- that she would provide an updated schedule by noon.

choices.A: promised
choices.B: warned us danger
choices.C: complained us
choices.D: advised a fact

questions.translationJa: プロジェクト責任者は、正午までに更新日程を提示すると約束しました。
questions.explanationJa: 将来の行為を引き受ける発言なのでpromisedが適切です。

questions.prompt: Because the report was written at the same office, the writer retained the word ------- when quoting the receptionist's location.

choices.A: there only
choices.B: the day before
choices.C: earlier
choices.D: here

questions.translationJa: 報告書が同じ事務所で書かれたため、筆者は受付担当者の場所を引用する際にhereを残しました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告者も同じ場所にいるなら、hereを機械的にthereへ変える必要はありません。
questions.focus: 場所が同じ場合のhere保持

questions.prompt: The vendor said that it had revised the price list -------.

choices.A: next week
choices.B: the previous week
choices.C: tomorrow
choices.D: now

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は、前の週に価格表を改訂したと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の報告時点から見たlast weekはthe previous weekで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a statement made in another city.

choices.A: Mina said that I was staying here for three nights regardless of viewpoint.
choices.B: Mina said was she staying there for three nights.
choices.C: Mina said that she was staying there for three nights.
choices.D: Mina told that she was staying there for three nights.

questions.translationJa: ミナは、そこで3泊すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 別の場所から報告するためhereをthereへ変え、内容節はshe wasの平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a promise.

choices.A: The supplier promised that it would replace the damaged units.
choices.B: The supplier promised us replace the damaged units.
choices.C: The supplier promised that would it replace the damaged units.
choices.D: The supplier promised to us that replacing the damaged units.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は損傷した製品を交換すると約束しました。
questions.explanationJa: promise＋that節が成立し、過去のpromisedから見た未来はwould replaceです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting something said the day before.

choices.A: The manager said that she approved the request tomorrow.
choices.B: The manager said that she had approved the request the day before.
choices.C: The manager said had she approved the request yesterday.
choices.D: The manager said that she has approving the request ago.

questions.translationJa: 部長は、前日に申請を承認していたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告より前の承認はhad approved、yesterdayはthe day beforeへ変えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence when the reporter remains in the same room and reports immediately.

choices.A: The receptionist says that the manager had been there the day before.
choices.B: The receptionist says is the manager here now.
choices.C: The receptionist said me the manager was there then.
choices.D: The receptionist says, “The manager is here now.”

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は今、「部長はここにいます」と言っています。
questions.explanationJa: 同じ場所・同じ現在時点の直接報告なのでhereとnowを保つことができます。
questions.focus: 状況が同じ場合の語句保持

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a reporting verb for a complaint.

choices.A: The passengers complained that the departure board was inaccurate.
choices.B: The passengers complained the staff that the board inaccurate.
choices.C: The passengers promised that the board was inaccurate.
choices.D: The passengers advised the board to be inaccurate.

questions.translationJa: 乗客たちは、出発案内板が不正確だと不満を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 不満を述べる内容にはcomplained thatが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting an admission.

choices.A: Mr. Brooks admitted me that he copied wrong the figures.
choices.B: Mr. Brooks admitted had he copied the wrong figures.
choices.C: Mr. Brooks admitted that he had copied the wrong figures.
choices.D: Mr. Brooks advised that he would copy the wrong figures.

questions.translationJa: ブルックスさんは、誤った数値を転記していたと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: admit＋that節を用い、認めた時点より前の行為をhad copiedで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a warning.

choices.A: The guide warned the river to might rise after the storm.
choices.B: The guide promised that the river might rise after the storm.
choices.C: The guide warned that might rise the river after the storm.
choices.D: The guide warned that the river might rise after the storm.

questions.translationJa: 案内係は、嵐の後に川が増水する可能性があると警告しました。
questions.explanationJa: warn＋that節を使い、that節内はthe river might riseの平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence changing a time expression from a past viewpoint.

choices.A: On Friday, Leo said that he completed the task two days ago from today.
choices.B: On Friday, Leo said that he had completed the task two days earlier.
choices.C: On Friday, Leo said that had he completed the task after two days.
choices.D: On Friday, Leo said that he would complete the task the day before yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 金曜日、レオは2日前に作業を完了していたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言時点から2日前を表すためtwo days earlierを用い、完了はhad completedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence preserving a time word because the report is on the same day.

choices.A: This morning, Sara said that she would finish the review today.
choices.B: This morning, Sara said that she would finish the review the day before.
choices.C: This morning, Sara said would she finish the review today.
choices.D: This morning, Sara told that she will finished the review that day.

questions.translationJa: 今朝、サラは今日中に確認を終えると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告も同じ日のうちならtodayを保てます。過去のsaidから見た未来にはwould finishを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting advice.

choices.A: The consultant advised that us kept copies of all receipts.
choices.B: The consultant advised us keeping copies to all receipts.
choices.C: The consultant advised us to keep copies of all receipts.
choices.D: The consultant complained us to keep copies of all receipts.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは、すべての領収書の控えを保管するよう私たちに助言しました。
questions.explanationJa: advise＋人＋to不定詞の型が正しく、助言の対象usも明示されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I arrived here yesterday,” Mei said on Monday.

choices.A: Mei said that she had arrived there the day before.
choices.B: Mei said that I would arrive here the next day.
choices.C: Mei promised to leave there on Tuesday.
choices.D: Mei asked whether yesterday had arrived.

questions.translationJa: メイは、前日にそこへ到着していたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: I→she、here→there、yesterday→the day before、arrived→had arrivedへ視点を組み直しています。
questions.focus: 人・場所・時間の総合変換

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The room is too cold,” several guests said.

choices.A: Several guests promised to cool the room.
choices.B: Several guests admitted that they had reserved the room.
choices.C: Several guests complained that the room was too cold.
choices.D: Several guests warned that the room would become crowded.

questions.translationJa: 数名の宿泊客は、部屋が寒すぎると不満を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言内容が不満なのでcomplained thatで機能を自然に表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I will deliver the samples tomorrow,” the representative said.

choices.A: The representative said that the samples had been delivered the day before.
choices.B: The representative asked whether someone could collect the samples that day.
choices.C: The representative said that the sample delivery had been canceled.
choices.D: The representative said that the samples would be delivered the next day.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は、サンプルは翌日に配送されると述べました。
questions.explanationJa: willをwouldへ、tomorrowをthe next dayへ変え、元の配送予定を保った間接話法です。
questions.focus: 未来表現とtomorrowの視点移動

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The train left ten minutes ago,” the clerk said.

choices.A: The clerk said that the train would leave in ten minutes.
choices.B: The clerk said that the train had left ten minutes earlier.
choices.C: The clerk asked whether the train had arrived.
choices.D: The clerk said the train had been waiting for ten minutes.

questions.translationJa: 係員は、列車が10分前に出発していたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言時点から遡るagoをearlierへ変え、報告より前の出発をhad leftで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Be careful; the floor may be wet,” the attendant said.

choices.A: The attendant promised that the floor would be cleaned.
choices.B: The attendant complained that we had made the floor wet.
choices.C: The attendant warned us that the floor might be wet.
choices.D: The attendant admitted that the floor was always dry.

questions.translationJa: 係員は、床が濡れている可能性があると私たちに注意しました。
questions.explanationJa: 危険への注意をwarnedで表し、mayを過去視点のmightへ変えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I forgot to attach the receipt,” Ana said.

choices.A: Ana admitted that she had forgotten to attach the receipt.
choices.B: Ana advised us to remove the receipt.
choices.C: Ana promised to attach a different invoice.
choices.D: Ana complained that someone had sent too many receipts.

questions.translationJa: アナは領収書を添付し忘れたと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: 自分のミスを認める発言なのでadmitted thatが自然で、忘れた行為は報告より前です。
questions.focus: admitによる発言機能の表現

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning when the words are reported later from another place: “We are meeting here today,” the team leader said.

choices.A: The team leader said that the team had canceled every meeting.
choices.B: The team leader said that the team was meeting there that day.
choices.C: The team leader asked the team to travel there the next day.
choices.D: The team leader said that only one person was meeting here tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: チームリーダーは、チームがその日そこで会議をしていると述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 後の別地点からの報告なのでhereはthere、todayはthat dayへ変え、進行中の内容をwas meetingで保ちます。
questions.focus: 報告地点・報告時点によるhereとtodayの変換

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “You should back up the files,” the technician said to me.

choices.A: The technician admitted deleting the backup files.
choices.B: The technician promised that I would back up his files.
choices.C: The technician complained that the files were too large.
choices.D: The technician advised me to back up the files.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は私に、ファイルをバックアップするよう助言しました。
questions.explanationJa: shouldを含む助言の発言機能をadvised me toで簡潔に再構成しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I will not share the password,” Kim said.

choices.A: Kim said that someone had already shared her password.
choices.B: Kim said that she would not share the password.
choices.C: Kim asked another person to publish the password.
choices.D: Kim warned that the password would expire immediately.

questions.translationJa: キムさんは、そのパスワードを共有しないと述べました。
questions.explanationJa: Iをshe、will notをwould notへ変え、発言内容を余計な意味を加えずに報告しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The branch will close next week,” the notice said.

choices.A: The notice stated that the branch would close the following week.
choices.B: The notice said the branch had opened the previous week.
choices.C: The notice asked whether the branch was open today.
choices.D: The notice advised the branch to remain open.

questions.translationJa: 通知には、支店が翌週に閉鎖すると記されていました。
questions.explanationJa: will→would、next week→the following weekとして過去の通知時点から再構成しています。

questions.prompt: Nora called from the airport and said, “I am waiting here.” When I briefed the driver later, I said that Nora was waiting -------.

choices.A: here at my office
choices.B: tomorrow
choices.C: ago
choices.D: there

questions.translationJa: ノラは空港から電話し、「ここで待っています」と言いました。後で運転手に説明した際、私はノラがそこで待っていると伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告者は空港とは別の場所にいるため、元発言のhereをthereへ変えます。

questions.prompt: The customer spoke to us on Thursday about a Wednesday delivery. She said that the parcel had arrived -------.

choices.A: the next day
choices.B: tomorrow
choices.C: the day before
choices.D: now

questions.translationJa: 顧客は木曜日に、水曜日の配送について話しました。荷物は前日に到着したと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 木曜日の発言から見たWednesdayはthe day beforeです。

questions.prompt: At 3:00, the receptionist said, “The technician left ten minutes ago.” In the 4:00 log, this became: the technician had left ten minutes -------.

choices.A: earlier
choices.B: later tomorrow
choices.C: ago from 4:00 only
choices.D: next

questions.translationJa: 3時に受付担当者は「技術者は10分前に出ました」と言いました。4時の記録では、技術者はその発言の10分前に出ていたと記されました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の発言時点を基準にするためagoをearlierへ変えます。

questions.prompt: The manager is still in the same conference room and is reporting immediately. She can naturally say that the projector is -------.

choices.A: there by rule in every case
choices.B: here
choices.C: the previous day
choices.D: earlier

questions.translationJa: 部長は今も同じ会議室にいて、すぐに報告しています。そのため、プロジェクターはここにあると自然に言えます。
questions.explanationJa: 場所が変わっていないのでhereを保持できます。語句は状況に応じて変えるもので、機械的変換ではありません。

questions.prompt: A guest said, “The Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes.” The desk agent recorded that the guest had ------- about an unstable connection.

choices.A: promised
choices.B: advised
choices.C: congratulated
choices.D: complained

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客は「Wi-Fiが数分おきに切れます」と言いました。フロント担当者は、不安定な接続について苦情があったと記録しました。
questions.explanationJa: 不満を述べた発言なのでcomplainedが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: The supplier wrote, “We will send a replacement tomorrow.” In our Monday record, we noted that it had promised to send one -------.

choices.A: the day before
choices.B: ago
choices.C: the next day
choices.D: last yesterday

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は「明日交換品を送ります」と書きました。月曜日の記録で、翌日に1つ送ると約束したと記しました。
questions.explanationJa: 元発言のtomorrowを過去の記録視点からthe next dayへ変えます。

questions.prompt: The engineer discovered that he had used an outdated diagram. In the review meeting, he ------- that the mistake was his.

choices.A: warned us danger
choices.B: admitted
choices.C: promised
choices.D: advised

questions.translationJa: 技術者は古い図面を使用していたことに気付きました。レビュー会議で、その誤りは自分のものだと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: 自分の誤りを認める文脈なのでadmittedが適切です。

questions.prompt: On June 1, the organizer said, “Registration closes next Friday.” A report written later stated that registration would close -------.

choices.A: the following Friday
choices.B: the previous Friday
choices.C: today
choices.D: five minutes earlier

questions.translationJa: 6月1日、主催者は「登録は次の金曜日に締め切ります」と言いました。後日の報告には、登録は翌週の金曜日に締め切ると記されました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の発言でのnext Fridayは、後から報告するとthe following Fridayになります。

questions.prompt: During the same-day afternoon briefing, the supervisor referred to work due before midnight. Because the calendar day had not changed, she could retain -------.

choices.A: the day before only
choices.B: tomorrow only
choices.C: today
choices.D: ago

questions.translationJa: 同日の午後の説明で、上司は深夜までに必要な作業に言及しました。日付が変わっていないため、todayをそのまま使えました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告日が元発言と同じならtodayを保持しても指示対象は変わりません。

questions.prompt: The consultant did more than describe a possible tax issue; she recommended a specific precaution. The minutes therefore say that she ------- us to keep the supporting documents.

choices.A: complained
choices.B: admitted
choices.C: promised us that we kept
choices.D: advised

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは税務上の可能性を説明しただけでなく、具体的な予防策を勧めました。そのため議事録には、証拠書類を保管するよう私たちに助言したとあります。
questions.explanationJa: 具体的な推奨を相手に与えたため、advised us to keepが最適です。
questions.focus: 助言機能に合う伝達動詞
